changeSet.author: mherman22

preConditions.sqlCheck: select count(*) from clinlims.site_information where name = 'freezer.monitoring.enabled' and value_type <> 'boolean';

changeSet.comment: Correct value_type on an already-seeded freezer.monitoring.enabled row. 089's insert is guarded on the row not existing, so a database that ran the pre-rename 070 file keeps that file's value_type 'text' and renders the setting as a free-text box on Site Information - where anything but the literal "true" reads back as false through SystemConfigService.isMonitoringEnabled and silently stops all polling.
